correctness.rationale: From X=0 and A=-aI, L0(H)=-2aH and the exprb32 defect equals -c_a(h)^2 QGQ. Thus X+=c_a(h) Q^{1/2}(I-kappa_a(h)Q^{1/2}GQ^{1/2})Q^{1/2} with c=h phi1(-2ah)>0 and kappa=2h^2 phi1 phi3. Sylvester inertia on range Q makes positive semidefiniteness equivalent to kappa*mu<=1 (including singular Q and equality rank drop). Positive integral representations strictly increase kappa from 0 to 1/(4a^2) for a>0, and kappa0=h^2/3. For scalar a=0, y=x sqrt(g/q) and t=h sqrt(qg), y<=1 yields E>=y+delta(1-t^2/3), and y>=1 bounds negative delta and quadratic correction; necessity at y=0 gives t<=sqrt3 and an artificial zero output at equality. Large-h damping asymptotic follows from phi closed forms. Independently evaluated sample PSD spectra from noncommuting Q,G and the inequality, without interpreting samples as general proof.
residual_risks: Finite independent checks are corroborative; unrestricted theorem rests on mathematical reductions and exact certificates, not samples.
